fragment_1.title: Fragment I — The Path and the Water
fragment_1.translation: Dear friend, you must find the path to the river. The water shows the truth.
fragment_1.hint: The baker and the guard know the roads. Talk to them and find out how to get to the river.

fragment_2.title: Fragment II — The Woodcutter and the Bridge
fragment_2.translation: The woodcutter knows the bridge. Ask about the key.
fragment_2.hint: Explore the forest and look for the woodcutter.

fragment_3.title: Fragment III — The Answer in the River
fragment_3.translation: The answer lies under the bridge. Go home.
fragment_3.hint: Go to the riverbank and find what is under the bridge.

ui.Esa hipótesis no encaja todavía. Observa: That guess doesn't fit yet. Look at the context again.
ui.Despiertas sin recuerdos.\n\nEl pueblo g:
You wake up with no memories.

The village falls silent as it watches you. You carry only a notebook and a letter you cannot understand.

You must find out who you are, what the letter says and how to leave Nara, %s.
